pairs.subject: asset-class-poly-budgeting
pairs.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/mesh-finish.ts:473 The triangle budget in targetFaces goes straight to QuadriFlow, whose target_faces counts quads (scripts/visual-gen/pof_mesh_finish.py:307 passes int(target_faces) unchanged). Nothing calls providerFaceLimit({topology:'quads'}), so a quadriflow finish triangulates on GLB export at about 2x the authored budget, which is the exact quad trap face-budget.ts was written to prevent.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/polycount-presets.ts:29 face-budget.ts:29 declares FACE_BUDGET_UNIT='triangles', but the authoritative preset field is still the un-united faceLimit, and face-budget.ts:7 itself says presets author 'with no unit stated'. generationPlanFor and planPartBudget rationales say 'faces', and mesh-finish.ts:226 documents targetFaces as 'roughly this many faces'. The technique says to rename such a field, not leave it.

src/lib/visual-gen/mesh-finish.ts:473 The named floor-not-round function exists (face-budget.ts:76-80, undefined for junk input). The quad-counting remesher edge in this context skips it and hands the triangle budget over as a quad target.

src/lib/visual-gen/face-budget.ts:121 The ratio, the 1.1 tolerance and the named 1.8-2.2 band are all realized. But the attribution never checks request.topology, so a triangle-topology request (what every in-repo caller sends) at 2x is told 'a quad-topology request must be halved'. That is the misattribution the technique's decision rule forbids. A delivery far under budget is also silently 'honored'.

src/lib/visual-gen/polycount-presets.ts:148 The header comment (lines 13-17) states the shaping rule, but generationPlanFor gives every budgeted asset its class number as the generation request. RunnerStartInput has no per-asset budget field, which is the one-number-per-class policy the technique replaces.

src/lib/visual-gen/polycount-presets.ts:186 planPartBudget divides only when naive*parts overruns the whole, floors, returns a constrained flag plus a rationale, and refuses an unknown class or parts<1. It has no production caller, and no assembled-whole measurement is wired.

src/lib/visual-gen/polycount-presets.ts:261 Budget-blind generators get the class ceiling and a declared stage with no fabricated request. gradeFaceBudget returns unmeasured with a reason when a request or measurement is missing, resolveAssetClass reports class-blind degradation, and warnAbove is 1.5x faceLimit.
